notes: km 0 (départ réel) is placed on the N-340 at the eastern end of Tarragona's Via Augusta (41.12381, 1.28256), medium confidence: the official itinerary rows Cala Romana 0.6, Monnars 2.0 and La Móra 5.7 all fall within ~0.3 km of the routed path from this point; the neutralised roll-out from the city centre is not included. Length 168.5 km follows the seed and the cyclingstage 'times' table (KOMs 141.6/153.8/166.0, finish-line passages 144.1/156.3, finish 168.5); the PIMEC timetable PDF gives 168.4 / 168.3 km and its circuit kms are 0.1 km lower (Fonts 137.4, KOM 141.5, Estadi 144.0 ...). Routing through the waypoints on Overture roads gives ~167.3-168.0 km. The coastal/N-340 approach measures ~0.5-0.9 km shorter than the official kms, while each 12.2 km Montjuïc lap measures ~12.6 km on the mapped streets: Fonts -> Paral·lel -> Passeig de Montjuïc -> castle is ~4.6 km against an official 4.1 km. Therefore only the KOM and finish-line kms of the circuit are used as fixed official values; the kms of all other circuit points (Fonts, Paral·lel, Palaudàries, climb foot, Zona Franca, Polvorí ...) are derived from the path and differ from the PIMEC values by up to ~0.5 km. Route: N-340 from Tarragona (Cala Romana, Monnars, La Móra) then the N-340 dual-carriageway variant bypassing Altafulla/Torredembarra (vias keep the router off the old town roads), Creixell, Roda de Berà, El Vendrell, then C-31 Calafell (via Carretera de Bellvei), Segur, Cunit, Cubelles; at the Cubelles roundabout C-246a along the coast to Vilanova i la Geltrú (Av. de Cubelles, Rambla de Josep Tomàs Ventosa / Rambla de l'Exposició, Av. d'Eduard Toldrà, Rambla del Garraf) and Les Roquetes. Sitges: the itinerary row reads 'Sitges (C-246a -> VC -> C-246a -> C-31)' at 52.0 km, and a straight transit leaves the path ~2.3 km short of Vallcarca (62.2). The 'VC' (urban road) section is therefore modelled as a seafront loop Passeig de Vilanova -> Av. de Navarra -> Passeig Marítim -> Av. de Sofia -> back on Passeig de Vilanova / Av. d'Artur Carbonell (+1.6 km), low confidence; the old-town link to the Carretera de les Costes follows Hort Gran / Rafael Llopart / Emili Picó / Sant Honorat because the graph has no direct Hort Gran - Costes connection (affects <0.1 km). Then C-31 Costes del Garraf (Vallcarca, Garraf), leaving it at Les Botigues for the seafront road (Passeig Marítim of Castelldefels, Carrer de Llevant / Av. d'Europa in Gavà Mar), Av. del Mar, Plaça de la Terra, B-210, B-204 Carretera de la Vila into Viladecans, Av. de la Generalitat / Av. de Gavà (C-245) with the intermediate sprint at 85.6 (by-km position), Gavà, Av. de l'Eramprunyà and the BV-2041 Côte de Begues (foot 88.1, top 94.2 / 399 m; DEM gives ~408 m at the summit point on Begues' Ronda Urbana), Ronda Urbana, BV-2411 to Olesa de Bonesvalls (104.8), BV-2410 over the Pla del Pèlag to Les Casetes d'en Julià (113.2), then N-340 through Vallirana, Cervelló, La Palma (old N-340 forced instead of the parallel motorway), Molins de Rei, Sant Feliu, Sant Just, Esplugues, L'Hospitalet (Carretera de Collblanc) and Barcelona (Carrer de Sants, Creu Coberta) to Plaça d'Espanya, up Av. de la Reina Maria Cristina to the Fonts de Montjuïc where the race turns back down to start the circuit. Circuit (3 passages over the Montjuïc climb, 2 full laps + run-in; streets from the beteve / vilaweb / 3cat closure notices, order reconstructed on the map): Fonts (Plaça de Carles Buïgas) -> Av. de la Reina Maria Cristina -> Plaça d'Espanya -> Av. del Paral·lel -> Carrer de Palaudàries -> Passeig de Montjuïc -> Camí de la Font Trobada -> Passeig de Miramar -> Plaça de Carles Ibáñez -> Av. de Miramar -> Carretera de Montjuïc -> Av. del Castell (KOM ~172 m DEM; climb 1.6 km with 600 m at ~13 % per beteve) -> Passeig del Migdia -> Passeig Olímpic (finish line at the top of the ~700 m rise from the roundabout, DEM ~65 -> 108 m) -> Av. de l'Estadi -> Carrer dels Jocs del 92 -> Carrer del Foc -> Passeig de la Zona Franca -> Carrer de la Foneria -> Carrer del Segura -> Carrer del Polvorí -> Av. de Francesc Ferrer i Guàrdia -> Fonts. Every pass of every circuit point is listed separately. Finish: Passeig Olímpic in front of the Estadi Olímpic Lluís Companys (41.36470, 2.15764), the same point as the stage 1 TTT finish. Race roads are closed, so one-way restrictions were ignored except on motorways/trunks. Extra unnamed 'between ...' points are routing fill points (≤5 km apart, ≤1-2 km in towns, extra points at hairpins on the Côte de Begues and on Montjuïc, where straight-line < 60 % of the km difference is expected). By-km town points are placed by interpolation between fixed points and are only medium/low confidence; 'high' is not used because no official GPX/roadbook coordinates were available. [geodata G: after each Montjuïc KOM a via point on Passeig del Migdia (Overture c97f7e1f, mid-segment): the router took Passeig Olímpic down to the Migdia/Olímpic roundabout and the same road back up, a U-turn the notes do not describe (they give Migdia down, Olímpic up); km of the new points = KOM km + 0.87 (routed distance)] [geodata G: km of the Passeig del Migdia via points corrected to the routed distance from the KOM (1.21 km)]
